_notes: KinMS backend template (Monte Carlo cloudlets; supports freeform SB and finite thickness).
Install: pip install 'kinms>=3.0.14'. Likelihood is noisy — prefer a sampler, not lbfgs/bfgs.
JSON does not allow // comments — use _keys for notes.
Copy this file, set dataset/out/spectral/priors, then: pyuvkin fit template_kinms.json
_image_centre_note: source offset [dRA, dDec] arcsec from the phase centre
_model_note: more n_samples → smoother but slower. scale_height_arcsec 0 = thin. freeform also accepts clouds_per_pixel, cloud_seed, vlos_seed. rotation_curve: arctan|tanh|exponential|isothermal (no rings)
_surface_brightness_note: analytic: exponential disc. freeform: omit intensity/scale_radius priors (morphology from moment map)
_search_note: KinMS likelihood is stochastic — use nautilus/dynesty/emcee. Avoid lbfgs/bfgs
